SELECT cccr.*, ( SELECT cc.contract_number FROM con_contract cc WHERE cc.contract_id = ( cccr.contract_id ) ) AS contractNumber, ( SELECT cc.contract_name FROM con_contract cc WHERE cc.contract_id = ( cccr.contract_id ) ) AS contractName, ( SELECT cc.contract_id FROM con_contract cc WHERE cc.contract_id = ( cccr.contract_id ) ) AS contract_id, ( select pq.quotation_number from prj_quotation pq where pq.QUOTATION_ID=cccr.quotation_id) quotationNumber, (SELECT scvb.MEANING FROM sys_code_value_b scvb WHERE scvb.CODE_ID=( SELECT scb.CODE_ID FROM sys_code_b scb WHERE scb.CODE='CON_CHANGE_REQ_STATUS' ) AND scvb.VALUE=cccr.status) as currentStatus, ( select sd.history_data from sys_document_history_detail sd,sys_document_history sh where sh.document_id=cccr.change_req_id and sd.history_id=sh.history_id and sd.table_name='con_contract' ) penalty_data FROM con_contract_change_req cccr WHERE cccr.change_type = 'PENALTY_EXEMPT'
and cccr.contract_id=#{contractId}
and cccr.contract_id in (SELECT cc.contract_id FROM con_contract cc WHERE cc.project_id = #{projectId})
ORDER BY CREATION_DATE

SELECT * FROM con_contract_cancel ccc WHERE
ccc.contract_id=#{contractId}
ccc.contract_id in (SELECT cc.contract_id FROM con_contract cc WHERE cc.project_id = #{projectId})
ORDER BY CREATION_DATE

select t.* from (SELECT cccr.*, (SELECT scvb.MEANING FROM sys_code_value_b scvb WHERE scvb.CODE_ID=( SELECT scb.CODE_ID FROM sys_code_b scb WHERE scb.CODE='CON.CONTRACT_STATUS' ) AND scvb.VALUE=(SELECT cc.contract_status FROM con_contract cc WHERE cc.contract_id=cccr.contract_id)) as contractStatus, (SELECT scvb.MEANING FROM sys_code_value_b scvb WHERE scvb.CODE_ID=( SELECT scb.CODE_ID FROM sys_code_b scb WHERE scb.CODE='CON_CHANGE_REQ_STATUS' ) AND scvb.VALUE=cccr.status) as currentStatus, (SELECT cc.contract_name FROM con_contract cc WHERE cc.contract_id=cccr.contract_id) as contract_name, (SELECT cc.contract_number FROM con_contract cc WHERE cc.contract_id=cccr.contract_id) as contract_number, (select scvb.MEANING from sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scvb where scb.CODE_ID = scvb.CODE_ID and scb.CODE = 'CON.CONTRACT_CHANGE_TYPE' and scvb.VALUE = cccr.change_type)change_type_desc, bp.bp_class FROM con_contract_change_req cccr,con_contract cc,hls_bp_master bp WHERE cc.contract_id = cccr.contract_id and cc.tenant_id = bp.BP_ID
and cccr.contract_id=#{contractId}
and cccr.contract_id in (SELECT cc.contract_id FROM con_contract cc WHERE cc.project_id = #{projectId})
ORDER BY cccr.CREATION_DATE desc) t where ROWNUM = 1

SELECT cci.*,pq.quotation_number, (SELECT cc.contract_name FROM con_contract cc WHERE cc.contract_id = cci.contract_id) as contract_name, (SELECT cc.contract_number FROM con_contract cc WHERE cc.contract_id = cci.contract_id) as contract_number, (SELECT scvb.MEANING FROM sys_code_value_b scvb WHERE scvb.CODE_ID=( SELECT scb.CODE_ID FROM sys_code_b scb WHERE scb.CODE='CON_CHANGE_REQ_STATUS' ) AND scvb.VALUE=cci.status) as currentStatus FROM con_contract_incept cci left join prj_quotation pq on pq.quotation_id = cci.quotation_id WHERE
cci.contract_id=#{contractId}
cci.contract_id in (SELECT cc.contract_id FROM con_contract cc WHERE cc.project_id = #{projectId})
ORDER BY cci.CREATION_DATE

SELECT * FROM csh_payment_req_ln cprl WHERE
cprl.source_doc_category='CON_CONTRACT' AND cprl.source_doc_id=#{contractId}
cprl.source_doc_category='CON_CONTRACT' AND cprl.source_doc_id IN ( SELECT contract_id FROM CON_CONTRACT WHERE project_id IN ( ( SELECT PROJECT_ID FROM PRJ_PROJECT WHERE REF_PROJECT_ID = #{projectId} ) UNION ( SELECT project_id FROM PRJ_PROJECT WHERE manufacturer_id = ( SELECT bp_id FROM prj_project_bp WHERE BP_TYPE = 'MANUFACTURER' AND PROJECT_ID = #{projectId} ) ) ) )
ORDER BY CREATION_DATE

SELECT ccs.*, (SELECT scvb.MEANING FROM sys_code_value_b scvb WHERE scvb.CODE_ID=( SELECT scb.CODE_ID FROM sys_code_b scb WHERE scb.CODE='HLS_WFL_STATUS' ) AND scvb.VALUE=ccs.status) as currentStatus FROM con_contract_sign ccs WHERE
ccs.contract_id=#{contractId}
ccs.contract_id in (SELECT cc.contract_id FROM con_contract cc WHERE cc.project_id = #{projectId})
ORDER BY CREATION_DATE

SELECT pp.*, hbm.bp_name as bpName, (select fe.name from fnd_employee fe where fe.employee_id=(select project_assistant from HLS_CREDIT_LINE_CHANCE WHERE CHANCE_ID = pp.CHANCE_ID))employeeIdName, (SELECT scvb.MEANING FROM sys_code_value_b scvb WHERE scvb.CODE_ID=( SELECT scb.CODE_ID FROM sys_code_b scb WHERE scb.CODE='PRJ501_PRJ_STATUS' ) AND scvb.VALUE=pp.project_status) as currentStatus, (select max(ppm.process_instance_id) from prj_project_meeting ppm where ppm.project_id = pp.project_id) process_instance_id FROM prj_project pp, hls_bp_master hbm WHERE pp.TENANT_ID = hbm.BP_ID
and pp.project_id=#{projectId}
and pp.project_id in ( SELECT cc.project_id FROM con_contract cc WHERE cc.contract_id=#{contractId} )
ORDER BY pp.CREATION_DATE

SELECT ccter.*, (SELECT cc.contract_name FROM con_contract cc WHERE cc.contract_id = ccter.contract_id) as contract_name, (SELECT cc.contract_number FROM con_contract cc WHERE cc.contract_id = ccter.contract_id) as contract_number, (SELECT scvb.MEANING FROM sys_code_value_b scvb WHERE scvb.CODE_ID=( SELECT scb.CODE_ID FROM sys_code_b scb WHERE scb.CODE='HLS_WFL_STATUS' ) AND scvb.VALUE=ccter.status) as currentStatus FROM con_contract_termination ccter WHERE
ccter.contract_id=#{contractId}
ccter.contract_id in (SELECT cc.contract_id FROM con_contract cc WHERE cc.project_id = #{projectId})
ORDER BY CREATION_DATE

SELECT nvl(SUM(cccsh.due_amount),0) as dueAmount, nvl(SUM(cccsh.received_amount),0)as receivedAmount FROM con_contract_cashflow cccsh WHERE cccsh.cf_item = '9' and cccsh.cf_status = 'RELEASE'
AND cccsh.contract_id=#{contractId}
AND cccsh.contract_id in (SELECT cc.contract_id FROM con_contract cc WHERE cc.project_id = #{projectId})
ORDER BY CREATION_DATE

SELECT SUM(cprl.amount) as dueAmount, SUM(cprl.amount_paid) as amountPaid FROM csh_payment_req_ln cprl,csh_payment_req_hd hd WHERE cprl.source_doc_category='CON_CONTRACT' and cprl.payment_req_id=hd.payment_req_id and hd.payment_req_status='APPROVED'
AND cprl.source_doc_id=#{contractId}
AND cprl.source_doc_id IN ( SELECT contract_id FROM CON_CONTRACT WHERE project_id IN ( ( SELECT PROJECT_ID FROM PRJ_PROJECT WHERE REF_PROJECT_ID = #{projectId} ) UNION ( SELECT project_id FROM PRJ_PROJECT WHERE manufacturer_id = ( SELECT bp_id FROM prj_project_bp WHERE BP_TYPE = 'MANUFACTURER' AND PROJECT_ID = #{projectId} ) ) ) )
ORDER BY cprl.CREATION_DATE

SELECT DISTINCT PROC_INST_ID_ as procInstId FROM act_hi_taskinst WHERE PROC_INST_ID_ = ( SELECT MAX(PROC_INST_ID_) FROM act_hi_procinst WHERE business_key_ = #{projectId} AND PROC_DEF_ID_ LIKE '%PROJECT_REPORT_WORK_FLOW%'
) AND PROC_DEF_ID_ LIKE concat('%', concat('%PROJECT_REPORT_WORK_FLOW%', '%'))

SELECT ahc1.MESSAGE_ as actMsg, ( SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v. CODE = 'WLF.ACTION' AND v.code_value = ahc1.MESSAGE_ ) actMsgN, ahc2.MESSAGE_ as userMsg, ahc1.ID_ as actMsgId, ahc2.ID_ as userMsgId, aha.ID_ as hiActId, aha.PROC_INST_ID_ as procInstId, aha.TASK_ID_ as taskId, aha.ACT_NAME_ as actName, aha.ASSIGNEE_ as assignee, ahc1.USER_ID_ as realAssignee, aha.START_TIME_ as startTime, aha.END_TIME_ as endTime, aha.ACT_TYPE_ as actType FROM act_hi_actinst aha left join act_hi_comment ahc1 on ahc1.TASK_ID_ = aha.TASK_ID_ left join act_hi_comment ahc2 on ahc2.TASK_ID_ = aha.TASK_ID_ WHERE aha.PROC_INST_ID_=#{processInstanceId} AND ( ( (ahc1.TYPE_ = 'action'AND ahc1.message_ != 'CARBON_COPY' ) OR ahc1.TYPE_ IS NULL ) ) and (ahc2.TYPE_='comment' or ahc2.TYPE_ is null) AND aha.ACT_TYPE_ NOT in('exclusiveGateway') ORDER BY aha.START_TIME_

SELECT cc.project_id,nvl(pp.CREDIT_FLAG,'') credit_flag, (SELECT scvb.MEANING FROM sys_code_value_b scvb WHERE scvb.CODE_ID=( SELECT scb.CODE_ID FROM sys_code_b scb WHERE scb.CODE='CON.CONTRACT_PROCESS_STATUS' ) AND scvb.VALUE=(SELECT cprh.payment_req_status FROM csh_payment_req_hd cprh where cprh.payment_req_id=cprl.payment_req_id)) as currentStatus, (SELECT ahp.START_USER_ID_ FROM act_hi_procinst ahp WHERE ahp.PROC_INST_ID_=( SELECT cprh.process_instance_id FROM csh_payment_req_hd cprh where cprh.payment_req_id=cprl.payment_req_id ))as taskUser, cprl.amount_paid as amountPaid, (select PAYMENT_STATUS from CSH_PAYMENT_REQ_HD rh where rh.payment_req_id = cprl.payment_req_id) as paymentFlag, (SELECT cprh.payment_req_date FROM csh_payment_req_hd cprh WHERE cprh.payment_req_id=cprl.payment_req_id)as applyPayDate, (SELECT cc.contract_number FROM con_contract cc WHERE cc.contract_id=(cprl.source_doc_id)) as contractNumber, (SELECT cc.contract_name FROM con_contract cc WHERE cc.contract_id=(cprl.source_doc_id)) as contractName, (SELECT cc.contract_id FROM con_contract cc WHERE cc.contract_id=(cprl.source_doc_id)) as contractId, (SELECT cprh.process_instance_id FROM csh_payment_req_hd cprh where cprh.payment_req_id=cprl.payment_req_id) as processInstanceId, ( SELECT pq.quotation_number FROM con_contract_cashflow ccc, prj_quotation pq WHERE ccc.generated_source_doc_id = pq.quotation_id AND pq.enabled_flag = 'Y' AND ccc.cf_item = 0 AND cprl.source_doc_line_id = ccc.cashflow_id ) quotationNumber FROM csh_payment_req_ln cprl,con_contract cc,prj_project pp WHERE cprl.source_doc_id = cc.contract_id and cc.project_id = pp.project_id and cprl.source_doc_category='CON_CONTRACT'
AND cc.contract_id=#{contractId}
AND cc.project_id in ( (select PROJECT_ID from PRJ_PROJECT where REF_PROJECT_ID = #{projectId}) UNION (select project_id from PRJ_PROJECT where manufacturer_id = (select bp_id from prj_project_bp where BP_TYPE = 'MANUFACTURER' and PROJECT_ID = #{projectId})) )
ORDER BY cprl.CREATION_DATE
